top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) rewards the discovery of GLP-1 physiology and of its active form, a principle that opened a field and has been confirmed independently for decades, with a mature, widening clinical consequence named in the citation. Omitting the person who identified and synthesised the active peptide would be harder to defend than a scope criticism that careful wording can answer. P002 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) keeps the secure physiological core and rests on a less disputed attribution, so it ranks second. Any B006 award is preferable to no award, since the science is mature and the maturity of the chain has not been challenged by any member.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; the documented co-authorship with Rickard Sandberg concerns single-cell work and no credited name on the slate
